{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsorsail skiff''' was a kind of vehicle using obsolete [[repulsorsail]] technology and mounted pontoons. One of the models was the [[G-62 Repulsorsail Skiff|Jal-paara G-62 Repulsorsail Skiff]].

Although obsolete in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], it was quite extended in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. [[Mix Liddell]] and [[MD-0C6]] owned repulsorsail skiffs, and [[Ackrahbala's Swoops & Speeders]], a business in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], rented these vehicles by 100 credits per day (including a 10% of the full value as a deposit).
